summary: 12 products: HYDROGEL_PACK (market-make), VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT (underlying + delta-hedge), and a 10-strike European call options chain VEV_XXXX with strikes 4000-6500. Options settle on VELVETFRUIT_EXTRACT. Pre-round data covers days 0-2 of a 5-day round (T=5,4,3). Implied vol calibrated at sigma≈1.5%/day, stable across all strikes and days.
